'''Pogranichnik''' is a 6★ [[Physical]] [[Vanguard]] [[Operator]] from [[Rhodes Island]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. He is a [[Sword]] user with both {{Color|Physical DMG|1}} dealing and SP recovery abilities. Consume multiple {{G|Vulnerable|Vulnerability}} stacks to maximize the effects of his skills.

==Profile==
"The situation is urgent. I respectfully request a brief on your battle plan, at your earliest convenience."<br/>Pogranichnik is a [[Rhodes Island]] operator assigned to [[Endfield Industries]] where he serves as a military consultant under the framework agreement between the two companies.<br/> With deep knowledge of military theory and hard-won experience in team combat, Pogranichnik leads his unit through even the most unexpected crises. Once commander of the Shieldguard Banner in the [[Order of Steel Oath]], he and his troops came to be regarded as among the most reliable on the front lines against the [[Aggeloi]]. But as the situation on [[Talos-II]] grew increasingly complex, he joined Endfield Industries without hesitation. He firmly believes that the [[Endministrator]] will lead Talos-II onto a new path, just as he once envisioned.<br/>"Endmin, I have no doubt that your actions will put a solemn end to this cruel cycle of war and sacrifice."
